script: Next, freelance marketplaces. Upwork suits writing, admin, data, design and virtual assistant work. You use connects to bid on jobs, so start with small, clearly written jobs. Fiverr suits packaged services with fixed prices, which suits designers and video editors. LinkedIn suits professional clients. Facebook and WhatsApp groups suit local small jobs. Read the group rules first, and never pay to join a job group. Check the current terms of any platform before you join. That includes fees, withdrawal options and country availability. Terms change, and this course cannot guarantee them. Let us put the profile formula into practice. Write your headline first, even if you change it later. Then write your summary in three short paragraphs. Read each paragraph out loud. If it sounds like a list of words, rewrite it as a sentence that a real person would say to a friend. Next, choose your three best samples, and give each one a short caption.
